name: Question 13
problem:
A particle $P$ is traveling along the $x$-axis with displacement $s(t)$ from a fixed origin $O$ given by

$$
s(t)={t}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(t),\,t\ge 0.
$$

Find the time at which the acceleration is zero, and find the value of the velocity at this moment.

Question 13
?

A particle P is traveling along the x-axis with displacement s(t) from a fixed origin O given by s(t)=t2ln⁡(t),t≥0. Find the time at which the acceleration is zero, and find the value of the velocity at this moment.

a
t=e−1/2,v=−2e−1/2
b
t=e−3/2,v=−2e−3/2
c
t=e−5/2,v=−2e−5/2
d
t=e−3/2,v=−e−3/2
e
t=e−5/2,v=−e−3/2
Submit
